# landerpilot-trae-mcp

landerpilot-trae-mcp is a Node.js MCP distribution package for Trae and LanderPilot. It packages a stdio bridge to LanderPilot Cloud MCP, a local stdio MCP server, setup scripts, doctor scripts, docs, blueprints, and local site-generation helpers.

## Positioning

Use this repository when a user needs to make LanderPilot MCP easy to install, verify, teach, or distribute in Trae. It is especially useful for course delivery, student onboarding, team setup, and local MCP debugging.

## Core Surfaces

### Cloud Bridge

`cloud-proxy.mjs` reads Trae MCP configuration and forwards stdio MCP calls to:

```text
https://landerpilot.com/api/mcp
```

### Local MCP Server

`server.mjs` exposes local LanderPilot helper tools through stdio MCP:

- `list_sites`
- `inspect_site`
- `list_template_slots`
- `prepare_deployment_handoff`
- `get_cloud_mcp_connection`

### Setup and Diagnosis

- `landerpilot-trae-setup`: writes Trae MCP configuration.
- `landerpilot-trae-doctor`: checks whether the Trae setup can see the expected MCP bridge.
- `npm run pack:check`: checks distribution readiness.

## Typical Install Flow

```bash
npm install -g github:yuanyuanyuan430/landerpilot-trae-mcp
landerpilot-trae-setup
```

Then fully restart Trae and ask:

```text
请调用 landerpilot_connection_status 检查连接。
```

## File Map

- `README.md`: human-facing project homepage.
- `llms.txt`: concise AI-readable project summary.
- `llms-full.txt`: expanded AI-readable project summary.
- `cloud-proxy.mjs`: Trae stdio to LanderPilot Cloud MCP bridge.
- `server.mjs`: local stdio MCP server.
- `scripts/setup-trae.mjs`: Trae setup helper.
- `scripts/doctor-trae.mjs`: Trae doctor command.
- `mcp.local.example.json`: local MCP config example.
- `mcp.remote.example.json`: cloud MCP config example.
- `docs/install.md`: full install guide.
- `docs/student-trae-quickstart.md`: student quickstart.
- `docs/teacher-distribution.md`: teacher distribution guide.
- `docs/windows-one-click.md`: Windows guide.
- `skills/landerpilot/`: LanderPilot skill and local generation tools.
- `blueprints/`: site blueprints.
- `generators/`: site generation helpers.
